correctness.rationale: For the exactly fourteen vertices of the Fano Levi graph, two independent complete tests enumerate all 16384 vertex subsets, determine every secure set by strict quantified adjacent-defender swaps, and agree on no secure sets below six and exactly 84 at six. Their independently constructed models use respectively binary orthogonality and the cyclic (7,3,1) difference set. Both prove the predicate equivalence (at cardinality <=6) with 3 points+3 lines+2 incidences, enabling analytic count 28*3=84. GL_3(F_2) transitivity gives a unique orbit; one BFS yields levels 1,4,8,16,28,22,4,1 and diameter seven, corroborated by all-source BFS in both programs. Exact embedded paths and output files were executed and reviewed; finite enumeration is exhaustive here only because domain size is 16384.

originality.rationale: Archive-era general secure-domination algorithm/bound papers and the inspected Heawood-specific alternate secure-vertex-edge invariant do not visibly state the present complete geometric classification and exchange distances. Published mathematical records and accessible related scientific statements were searched by parameter, graph, aliases, and implications. Earlier own results on ordinary Heawood domination and secure domination of a nonisomorphic 20-vertex graph do not logically cover this claim. The 2015 full paper was not accessible and a scanned 2013 source only partially inspected; residual source risk is explicitly retained and independent priority has not been established.
residual_risks: The full text of Merouane and Chellali (2015) was not accessible; a specific illustrative Heawood computation cannot be fully excluded from abstract-only evidence.
The 2013 JCMCC scanned full PDF was not searched exhaustively; only publisher abstract and visually read front page were compared.
The named Heawood 2024 secure-vertex-edge paper was accessible only through relevant excerpts; its definition is different but full text comparison is incomplete.
Unindexed graph-invariant tables and undocumented computational theses could contain equivalent 84-state or diameter-7 data.
No independent external scientific audit or publication priority certification.

value.rationale: The graph is the canonical fourteen-vertex Fano Levi graph, unique cubic 6-cage. Secure domination is a naturally motivated robust-guard invariant; its optimum six differs substantively from ordinary domination four. All 84 minima admit a simple incidence-geometric classification as marked noncollinear triples, form a single GL_3(F_2) orbit, and have a connected 4-regular exchange graph with sharp seven-move diameter. This is structural information about feasible robustness and mobility, not a generic unmotivated graph parameter or just a recalculation of a known count. The claim is expressly finite; broader application is not asserted.
